messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT detected for dedicated-pool-eu-west-1
incident-bot: metric: p99 latency = 12.4s (SLO 3s), p95 = 4.8s, queue_depth=420, streaming_stalls=high, affected_model=redwood-3-small, alert_id=INC-2026-1749004321
eric-oncall: ack-ing. paging SRE and Eng. I'll be on the bridge. /who's oncall for eu pools?
maria-sre: I'm on it — pulling metrics + traces now. link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/graphs/1749004321
junior-eng: quick grep of node logs shows repeated warmup failures and handshake timeouts: ```
2026-04-02T10:12:03Z warmup(task=kv-preload): error: deadline exceeded
2026-04-02T10:12:05Z handshake: timeout after 8s for slot=hotshot-3
2026-04-02T10:12:06Z stream: stall detected, last-token-ms=8200
```
maria-sre: looks like autoscaler didn't provision hotpool instances quickly enough for the burst. warmup queue backed up, prefix/KV cache coldpath causing long tails.
eric-oncall: any immediate mitigations we can run live to reduce customer impact?
kevin-product: Support already seeing errors. Olivia, how many customers impacted?
olivia-support: ~12 customers reported streaming interruptions, 3 opened escalations (enterprise). Most on EU region. Tracking thread: https://support.redwood/incidents/1749004321
sandeep-ops: propose immediate actions: 1) manual hotpool scale +4 GPUs in eu-west-1 2) enable fallback variant (redwood-3-small-q4) for streaming routes 3) reduce max_batch to 8 for this pool 4) temporary ingress rate cap for non-enterprise routes
maria-sre: doing 1) +4 GPUs now (manual provision request submitted). 2) triggering prewarm job to populate KV cache for top 50 prefixes. 3) increasing handshake timeout to 12s as temporary band-aid.
eric-oncall: executing traffic steering: routing 20% of incoming traffic to dedicated-pool-us-east-1 via routing policy (latency-aware fallback). Will post change id.
eric-oncall: routing-change-id: rout-1749004321-01 :white_check_mark:
junior-eng: prewarm job output (tail): ```
[10:18:12] prewarm: queued=50 started=12 complete=6 errors=0
[10:19:02] kv-populate: prefix=customer:ent-123 cache_hit=0->1
[10:20:11] prewarm: complete: succeeded=50
```
maria-sre: cache prewarm completed for top prefixes — expect p99 to start improving in ~30s as KV hits increase.
olivia-support: notified the 3 escalations with temporary mitigation notes (rate-limited + fallback margin). Customers acknowledged, one asked for ETA on full restoration.
kevin-product: what's ETA for full recovery if manual scale succeeds and warmup finishes?
sandeep-ops: if provision finishes cleanly and warmup caches hit, expect p99 < 3s in 6-10 mins. If autoscaler remains slow we'll keep manual pool for the next 30-60 mins.
eric-oncall: monitoring p99 trend — attaching live chart snapshot: https://metrics.redwood/shot/1749004321/p99.png
maria-sre: p99 trending down: 12.4 -> 6.7 -> 3.9 now. queue_depth dropping from 420 -> 160 -> 40.
junior-eng: noticed a burst pattern: many small clients ramped concurrently following a partner campaign. autoscaler backoff parameters might be too conservative for sudden bursts.
kevin-product: product note: partner campaign started at 10:09z, they didn't inform infra. We'll follow up with partnership to improve coordination.
olivia-support: keeping support updates going. CS wants a short summary we can send to affected customers.
eric-oncall: summary draft: "We experienced a capacity warmup and autoscaling delay in eu-west-1 causing transient streaming stalls and elevated p99. We've manually scaled and prewarmed caches; traffic was partially routed to us-east-1. Most customers restored within ~10 minutes. Follow-up postmortem will be posted." OK to send?
kevin-product: ok to send that with ETA for postmortem.
sandeep-ops: immediate follow-ups for ops/infra: - adjust autoscaler burst thresholds for hotshot pools - add faster warmup for recent prefix access patterns - add circuit to auto-enable fallback variant when p99 > 5s for >2m
maria-sre: creating incident runbook entry and assigning actions. runbook ticket: https://jira.redwood/INC-1749004321
eric-oncall: handing off live monitoring + postmortem to maria-sre for next 12h. I'll be available if escalation rises. :white_check_mark:
maria-sre: acknowledged handoff. will lead postmortem and write timeline. assigning to sandeep-ops for autoscaler tuning and junior-eng for logs correlation.
olivia-support: I'll attach the customer notifications and escalation logs to the incident ticket.
incident-bot: incident INC-2026-1749004321 updated: status=mitigated, severity=high, handlers=[maria-sre,sandeep-ops,eric-oncall]
eric-oncall: closing this live bridge. leave channel for asynchronous follow-ups. great quick teamwork, folks. :tada:
